package.name: trainit_cell_io
package.description: TrainIt simulation control of a cell's machines (P0.b; ADR-0013 Amendment P0): devices (binary actuators, position axes, digital sensors), station sequences (the python_logic backend), one ProcessDevice per machine service implementing the source's rules of the machine-service contract (trainit_interfaces ChannelRequest / ChannelStatus), and a plant adapter -- a deterministic mock with fault injection, or an Isaac Sim articulation through a std_msgs boundary and a ROS-side bridge. A cell-level process, started apart from the robot. Not a PLC, not a safety function (ADR-0033).
